test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four options have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
**Paracetamol is the odd one out.**

As it is a medicine used to treat fever.

While other three terms - Diabetes, Tuberculosis, Malaria are the diseases.

Hence,** 'option 4'** is the correct answer.
